_schema.cards: Array of EATK-* IDs (duplicates = multiple copies in hand)
_schema.exposedTags: Tags that match player item stealTags for pre-combat stealing
_schema.deckSize: Optional override — if set, randomly draws N from cards pool each combat

ARMORED_GUARD._combo: Anchor: Safety Interlock gates Aimed Shot one-shot. Steal the interlock = they can only pistol+shield.
ARMORED_GUARD._note: Defensive guard variant. Shield Wall + Pistol + Aimed Shot + Safety Interlock.

CHEM_TECH._combo: Anchor: Capacitor Bank stores charges for Taze chain. Fuel: Dead Battery feeds Overload Cannon threshold. Steal battery = starve cannon, steal capacitor = disable charge buildup.
CHEM_TECH._note: Status-control tech. Chemical + Taze + Spotlight + Capacitor Bank + Dead Battery.

CHURCH_CATACOMBS_WARDEN._combo: Anchor: Flicker Relay gates Cultist Zeal (dark-powered burst). Fuel: Broken Bulb increases darkness damage. Cursed: Flicker hurts own accuracy. Steal Relay = ritual fails, steal Bulb = darkness starved.
CHURCH_CATACOMBS_WARDEN._note: Catacombs warden: reveal/expose + stun + defensive wall + Flicker Relay + Broken Bulb.

CIVILIAN_BRAWLER._note: Brawler: heavy swing + grapple. Fight-club vibe.

CIVILIAN_TYPE_A._note: Baseline civilian: panics and lashes out with a small knife.

CIVILIAN_TYPE_B._note: Grabby civilian: grapple + knife. Mostly control.

CIVILIAN_TYPE_C._note: Shady civilian: coin toss distraction + knife. Loot-flavored.

CONSTRUCTION_WORKER._note: Worker with gear: axe tool swing + brief defensive brace.

CONTRABAND_RUNNER._note: Mid-tier thief. Coin Toss distraction + Knife + Flee.

DATACENTER_SECURITY._combo: Anchor: Safety Interlock gates Aimed Shot. Signal Amplifier gates reinforcement calls. Defense: Noise Gate protects from sonic. Steal Noise Gate = complete your Ultrasonic chain. Steal Interlock = neuter burst. Steal Signal = cut comms.
DATACENTER_SECURITY._note: Server room security: paint/spotlight + aimed shot + Safety Interlock + Signal Amplifier + Noise Gate.

DROWSY_BEE._note: 1 card with minor poison. Teaches DOT.

FIGHT_CLUB_THUG._combo: Cursed Anchor: Overclock Core gates Frenzy (double speed) but costs 2 HP per play. Dilemma: steal to prevent burst OR leave it and let self-damage whittle them down.
FIGHT_CLUB_THUG._note: Fight club: heavy hit + knife + grapple + Overclock Core.

GENERIC_FLOOR_15._combo: Fuel: Dead Battery pads hand, feeds Overload Cannon threshold at higher floors.
GENERIC_FLOOR_15._note: Pistol + Burst + Knife + Dead Battery. Junk padding starts appearing.

GENERIC_FLOOR_20._combo: Anchor: Safety Interlock gates Aimed Shot. Fuel: Loose Wiring extends chain lightning. First real combo dependency encounter.
GENERIC_FLOOR_20._note: Burst + Aimed + Knife + Shield + Safety Interlock + Loose Wiring.

GENERIC_FLOOR_25._combo: Anchor: Safety Interlock gates Grenade+Aimed Shot. Capacitor Bank stores charges for Taze chain. Fuel: Dead Battery feeds Overload Cannon. Full combo dependency pattern.
GENERIC_FLOOR_25._note: Burst + Aimed + Grenade + Taze + Safety Interlock + Capacitor Bank + Dead Battery.

GENERIC_FLOOR_30._combo: Full combo ecosystem. Anchor: Safety Interlock + Capacitor Bank gate burst + electrical. Defense: Thermal Stabilizer prevents overheating. Steal Stabilizer = complete your Overload Grid chain. Steal Interlock = neuter burst. No exposed tags — hard to steal from.
GENERIC_FLOOR_30._note: Full 8-card hand. Late-game guards with combo dependencies + defensive steal-target.

GHOST_OPERATIVE._combo: Anchor: Safety Interlock gates Shadow Strike one-shots. Cursed: Overclock Core enables Frenzy (double strike speed) but costs 2 HP. Steal Interlock = no burst. Leave Overclock = they self-damage. Glass cannon with self-destruct timer.
GHOST_OPERATIVE._note: 2x Shadow Strike + Knife + Safety Interlock + Overclock Core. High risk/reward.

GRANNY._note: Granny with a flashlight: exposes player (low damage but high stealth impact).

HEAVY_DRIFTER._combo: Defense: Thermal Stabilizer prevents overheating from tanking fire. Fuel: Loose Wiring adds chain spread. Steal Stabilizer = complete your Overload Grid chain. Still no exposed tags — brute force only.
HEAVY_DRIFTER._note: 2x Shield Wall + Axe + Pistol + Thermal Stabilizer + Loose Wiring. Tank with steal-target defense.

HOMEOWNER_DEFENDER._note: Home defense: pistol + defensive stance. Easy to de-escalate (bribe).

HYDROPONICS_TECH._note: Hydroponics worker-tech: chemical splash + flashlight + knife.

JUNKYARD_SCAVENGER._note: Junkyard: improvised grabs + knife + coin tricks.

LAZY_CATERPILLAR._note: 2 copies of Nibble. Slightly more durable tutorial enemy.

PYROMANIAC._combo: Defense: Thermal Stabilizer prevents self-burn from own incendiaries. Fuel: 2x Broken Bulb darkens area for fire visibility advantage. Steal Stabilizer = they take self-burn damage. Steal Bulbs = fuel your Prism Mine Lumen chain.
PYROMANIAC._note: 2x Incendiary + Frag + Thermal Stabilizer + 2x Broken Bulb. Fire specialist with darkness fuel.

SMOKE_ENFORCER._combo: Cursed: Overclock Core enables Frenzy Ram Charge (devastating charge combo) but costs 2 HP per activation. Fuel: Loose Wiring adds electrical stun to charge path.
SMOKE_ENFORCER._note: Ram + Pistol + Taze + Overclock Core + Loose Wiring. Aggressive charger with self-destruct.

SMOKE_SPOTTER._note: Turns smoke into a detection net. Spotlight + Paint Target + Pistol.

SMOKE_STALKER._combo: Cursed Anchor: Flicker Relay gates darkness-empowered Shadow Strike but hurts own accuracy. Fuel: Broken Bulb deepens darkness. Steal Relay = get light manipulation tool + break their ritual. Steal Bulb = starve darkness + gain Lumens.
SMOKE_STALKER._note: Shadow Strike + Knife + Grapple + Flicker Relay + Broken Bulb. Darkness-empowered stalker.

SPOTTER_DRONE._combo: Anchor: Signal Amplifier gates reinforcement calls. Defense: Noise Gate dampens sonic attacks. Steal Signal = cut comms (no backup). Steal Noise Gate = complete your Ultrasonic chain.
SPOTTER_DRONE._note: Paint Target + Spotlight + Pistol + Signal Amplifier + Noise Gate. Detection + comms specialist.

TRANSIT_ENFORCER._note: 2x Ram Charge + Pistol. Lane charger pattern.

TREASURE_GOBLIN._note: Coin Toss + 2x Flee. Wants to escape, not fight. Easy to steal from.

SURVEILLANCE_COMMANDER._combo: FLAGSHIP ECOSYSTEM DECK. Anchor: Safety Interlock gates Aimed Shot. Signal Amplifier gates reinforcements. Capacitor Bank stores charges for electrical burst. Fuel: 2x Dead Battery feeds Overload Cannon threshold. Defense: Noise Gate dampens sonic attacks. Steal priority matrix: Noise Gate = complete Ultrasonic chain. Signal Amplifier = cut comms. Safety Interlock = neuter burst. Dead Battery = free battery + starve cannon. Capacitor Bank = 2 battery + disable charges.
SURVEILLANCE_COMMANDER._note: Elite surveillance: Paint Target + Aimed Shot + Taze + Signal Amplifier + Safety Interlock + Capacitor Bank + Noise Gate + 2x Dead Battery. Full combo dependency ecosystem.

ELECTRICAL_OVERSEER._combo: Double Capacitor Bank = rapid charge buildup. 2x Dead Battery + Loose Wiring = triple electrical fuel. 2x Taze chains with stored charges. Thermal Stabilizer prevents self-damage from electrical overload. Steal Stabilizer = complete YOUR Overload chain + they start self-damaging. Steal Capacitors = starve all electrical combos.
ELECTRICAL_OVERSEER._note: Elite electrical: 2x Taze + Burst + 2x Capacitor Bank + 2x Dead Battery + Loose Wiring + Thermal Stabilizer.

CULT_ACOLYTE._combo: Cursed Anchor: Flicker Relay gates Cultist Zeal but costs -15% accuracy. Fuel: 2x Broken Bulb deepens darkness for Zeal power. Steal Relay = free light manipulation tool + break ritual. Steal Bulbs = starve darkness + gain Lumens for Prism Mine.
CULT_ACOLYTE._note: Cult acolyte: Shadow Strike + Knife + Flicker Relay + 2x Broken Bulb. Darkness ritualist.
